synthesis.notes: 9-AGNR was synthesized by CVD using DBTP as monomer at an annealing temperature of 400°C. steps.description: Simple mixing of one part cationic dye (Rhodamine 3B perchlorate) with two parts cyanostar macrocycle to produce SMILES materials. The dye's counter anions (ClO4-) form complexes with cyanostar, and the resulting disc-like 2:1 cyanostar-anion complexes direct crystal packing into an alternating charge-by-charge assembly.

Co-crystallization of the mixture produces SMILES crystals with alternating charge-by-charge packing of cationic dyes with anionic complexes. Crystals of various sizes (~2 µm to ~50 µm) were produced.

synthesis.notes: SMILES (small-molecule ionic isolation lattices) materials are prepared by a simple two-pot mix: one part cationic dye with two parts cyanostar. The cyanostar macrocycle binds the perchlorate counter anion of rhodamine 3B, forming a 2:1 cyanostar-anion complex that directs alternating ionic packing. synthesis.notes: Samples were characterized by powder diffraction/profile refinements to establish oxygen content and detailed crystallographic parameters. The crystal structure was found to be orthorhombic (Pnma) for x=1/3 over the entire range of temperature and field explored. Orthorhombic, rhombohedral, and monoclinic phases were observed in the doping range studied.
